description:
Write state into a private workspace (member only).

    Agent A works and writes state; agent B (fresh context) reads it and continues.
    This is the durable handoff — survives context loss. Only workspace members
    can write; outsiders get allowed:false.
    Sibling: vc_workspace_read, vc_workspace_list.

content.description: State to store — JSON object or text.
content.title: Content

note_key.description: Note key within the workspace, e.g. task-state.
note_key.title: Note Key

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE if not using X-Vibes-Key.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

name: vc_workspace_write
